verdict.rationale: Morph is a hosted API platform serving production traffic, so a public status page with incident history is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a status page, uptime reporting, or incident history. The standby 429 behavior and dedicated endpoints are adjacent reliability features, not a status page, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can check a public status page with incident history before betting production traffic on the platform
